verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's own features page says the CRM syncs with over 500 tools, including Slack, which shows a first-party catalog of prebuilt integrations. Its developer docs mention public apps and in-UI app extensions, which points to a third-party app ecosystem. The evidence never names an app marketplace or describes a one-click install flow, and only Slack among the story's categories is confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit app marketplace and install workflow docs, evidence of support-desk, marketing and data-warehouse integrations, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: Sync your CRM with over 500 tools, including Google, Quickbooks, Asana, Slack, Kixie and more
You can use our API to create public or private apps using OAuth 2.0 and integrations via API token.
With app extensions, the app’s functionality will be available directly inside the Pipedrive platform’s UI
